title: Explicit product columns and alternating restrictions for principal Cech complexes
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\in\mathbb N$ and $f:\operatorname{Fin}r\to A$. Use the section functors and principal intersections $D_S$ of [def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total]. For every $p\in\mathbb Z$ let $I_p$ be the finite type of nonempty subsets $S\subseteq\operatorname{Fin}r$ with $|S|=p+1$. Define the column functor $C_p(F)=\prod_{S\in I_p}\Gamma(D_S,F^\bullet)$ in the category of integer-indexed $A$-module complexes. Coefficient maps act by the categorical product of their section maps. Define $h_p:C_p\to C_{p+1}$ as the natural transformation whose projection to $S\in I_{p+1}$ is $\sum_{j\in S}(-1)^{|\{k\in S:k<j\}|}\operatorname{res}_{S\setminus\{j\},S}\circ\pi_{S\setminus\{j\}}$, omitting empty deletions. Restrictions are induced by the sheaf presheaf maps. This gives specified real constructions, including empty products in every absent row.
